info.title: CarVideoGameBackend — Unity Client API
info.description:
API de cliente para **CarVideoGameBackend** (Nakama 3.27, runtime JS). El backend no expone endpoints REST propios: toda la lógica de juego son **RPCs de Nakama** invocables en `POST /v2/rpc/{id}`. Este documento modela cada RPC como una operación para poder generar DTOs/clientes.

## Cómo se llama un RPC
1. Autenticar (`/v2/account/authenticate/device`) con `Authorization: Basic base64(SERVER_KEY:)` -> `token`.
2. Llamar `POST /v2/rpc/{id}` con `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
3. **El body HTTP es una cadena JSON** (el payload serializado como string), no un objeto. Sin payload: `""`.
4. La respuesta HTTP es `{ "payload": "<json string>" }`; dentro va el envelope `{ok:true,data}` o `{ok:false,error:{code,message}}`. El status HTTP es 200 incluso con errores de dominio: **ramificar por `ok`**.
5. Con el SDK de Unity: `client.RpcAsync(session, id, payloadJson)` ya hace el wrapping; `rpc.Payload` es el envelope.

## Autenticación / identidad
Sesión = Bearer JWT. La identidad sale **solo** de la sesión (`ctx.userId`, que Nakama rellena con Bearer). Los campos `callerUserId` (y `hostUserId` / `userId` en `race_session_create` / `race_session_join`) son opcionales y se mantienen por compatibilidad: si vienen deben ser el `uid` del JWT (si no -> `FORBIDDEN`). Sin sesión -> `UNAUTHENTICATED`.

## Reglas importantes
- Nunca escribir storage ni leaderboards desde el cliente (el servidor lo hace al cerrar la carrera).
- Tiempo de carrera: usar el offset de `config_get.serverTimeMs` y `race_session_start.startedAt`, no `DateTime.UtcNow`.
- Enviar `clientVersion` + `platform` en los RPCs que lo aceptan: habilita `UPGRADE_REQUIRED` y el gate de mantenimiento (`SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`).
- Los RPCs `admin_*` son **solo operador** (`http_key` + `adminKey`) y no están en este documento: se documentan en `docs/admin.md` (ver «Contract» en el `README.md`). Los RPCs de servidor a servidor de este documento son `ads_levelplay_callback` y los `rs_*` de los servidores de carrera dedicados (`rs_heartbeat`, `rs_join_validate`, `rs_session_start`, `rs_submit_results`, `rs_session_release`) (esquema `RuntimeHttpKey`; los `rs_*` con la etiqueta `server-to-server`).
- No hay eventos de carrera por socket: el resultado llega en la respuesta de `race_submit_result` (el envío que cierra la sesión trae `officialResults` y `rewards`) o con `race_session_get` (`state: closed` y `results`). `RaceCompleted` es un evento interno del servidor (ver `components/schemas/RaceCompletedEvent`). El socket solo lleva el relay de la partida (op codes en `docs/race-protocol-ops.md`) y el matchmaker.

Fuente de verdad: `modules/src/**` y `docs/unity-api.md`. Donde ambas difieren se siguió el código (p. ej. `friend_list_get` devuelve `friends`, `block_list` devuelve `blocks`).

post.description:
T-15: linking is native (P-02). The client links with the Nakama client API; this RPC only reads the identities Nakama verified and credits the bonus once (profile flag and coins in one wallet transaction). Errors: `BAD_REQUEST` (a `token` was sent: NATIVE_LINK_REQUIRED; unknown provider), `CONFLICT` with `details.reason = NOT_LINKED` (no linked identity, or `provider` not linked), `NOT_FOUND` (account gone). A native link of an identity owned by another account fails with HTTP 409 AlreadyExists: resolve it with `account_link_resolve_conflict`.

Mantenimiento: **bloqueado** con `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`.

post.summary: Resolves a native link conflict with sessions of both accounts (T-15)
post.description:
T-15: 1) the native link fails with AlreadyExists; 2) the client authenticates with that identity (`create: false`) and calls step `open` with that session, which returns `AccountLinkConflict`; 3) with the original session it calls step `resolve` with `choice: link` + `confirmText: TRANSFER` (the other account is deleted with the full account purge, which frees its identities) or `choice: cancel`; 4) after `link`, it links the identities again natively. Errors: `NOT_FOUND` (unknown, used or expired token; account gone), `BAD_REQUEST` (missing fields, confirmText, resolving from the account being deleted), `CONFLICT` NOT_LINKED (open without a linked identity).

Mantenimiento: **bloqueado** con `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`.

Called by LevelPlay, never by the client: configure this URL in the LevelPlay dashboard (Apps > Set S2S callback) with `http_key` and `unwrap`, and its Private Key = `LEVELPLAY_S2S_PRIVATE_KEY` of the server `.env`. post.summary: Submit the official results of the race (server-to-server)
post.description:
Called by a dedicated race server (headless build), never by the game client, with the runtime `http_key` in the URL and `serverKey` in the body (must equal `RACE_SERVER_SECRET` of the server `.env`, compared in constant time). The race server is the authority of a dedicated race: this call closes the session with confidence `server` (it feeds the time and wins leaderboards like `quorum`), pays the coins and XP of the humans and frees the server. Checks: every finisher (`dnf` false) has as many `laps` as the session and `sum(laps) == totalMs`; every human (`isBot` false) is a human of the roster, once; bots (`isBot` true, `userId` null or an id of the server) only appear in the results and are never paid. A human lap under the class minimum of the track does not reject the results: the session is closed with `flags.needsReview = true` (`reviewReason: lap_below_min`). Humans that are not listed, or listed with `dnf`, are DNF. Ranks: with the optional per-row `rank` (integer 1..rows, on every row or on none, no repeats) the server order rules; without it, finishers by `totalMs` (ties keep the sent order), then the DNFs. The reward row is chosen by the number of rows (humans and bots) rounded up to 2/4/6. A session still `created` is started implicitly (`startedAt` = now) in the same close, so a failed `rs_session_start` does not lose the results. Idempotent by `requestId`: a retry returns the same response and pays nothing more; another `requestId` on a closed session is `CONFLICT`.

Possible errors (`error.code`): `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` (`NOT_CONFIGURED`: `RACE_SERVER_SECRET` is empty, every call is rejected), `FORBIDDEN` (`BAD_SERVER_KEY`, or called with a player session; `NOT_ASSIGNED`: the session is not assigned to this server)), `NOT_FOUND`, `CONFLICT` (`BAD_STATE`: the session is closed; `VERSION_CONFLICT`), `INVALID_RESULT` (`details.reason`: `LAP_COUNT_MISMATCH`, `LAP_SUM_MISMATCH`, `LAP_NOT_POSITIVE`, `NOT_IN_ROSTER`, `DUPLICATE_RESULT`, `BOT_ID_CLASH`, `RANK_INCOMPLETE`, `RANK_OUT_OF_RANGE`, `DUPLICATE_RANK`, `ESTIMATED_NOT_BOT`, `ESTIMATED_WITH_DNF`), `BAD_REQUEST` (invalid body).

Maintenance: not gated.

totalMs.description: Finish time in ms; sum of `laps`

laps.description: Lap times in ms; as many as the laps of the session when the entry finished

dnf.description: Did not finish (`totalMs` and `laps` are then ignored)

rank.description: Finishing position decided by the server (1..number of rows, no repeats). Send it on every row or on none; when present it overrides the order by time

estimated.description: True for a bot that had not finished, placed by progress (bots only, with `dnf` false): its laps and totalMs are not checked, it is listed with totalMs 0 and abandoned false. Without `rank` it goes after the timed finishers and before the DNFs

userId.description: Bots get the id the server sent, else `bot_ds_{index}`

rewards.description: userId -> reward, same entries as `race_submit_result`; only the humans that were paid

serverKey.description: Shared secret, equal to RACE_SERVER_SECRET of the server `.env`

sessionId.description: Session assigned to this server (from the heartbeat `assignment`)

reason.description: Why the server gives the session up (logged)
